binders.binder: E, NormedAddCommGroup E, NormedSpace ℝ E
binders.expanded: Real normed carrier with arbitrary original norm; no inner product on E, completeness or finite-dimensionality premise.

Finite algebraic coordinate equivalence to EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), supplying the coordinate pairing and source R^d carrier. No isometry or relation between coordinate Euclidean norm and E norm. d=0 allowed.
Extended-real function, literal feasible subset, real curvature coefficient. Original values and set retained.

Definition4.1 properness inherited by the strong-convexity predicate: forall x, f x != bottom; exists x and real r with f x=coe r. The global witness is used to exclude top at supported points, including after coordinate transport.
Printed convex set V. For x,y in V and nonnegative weights summing to one, their weighted sum belongs to V. Empty V allowed.
Printed lambda >=0; zero allowed, no division by lambda.

Exact printed V subset dom partial f: for every p in V there exists an actual vector g whose GLOBAL coordinate support inequality holds at every u in R^d. No support construction is concluded; no restriction of support evaluation to V.
Universal feasible endpoints, strict 0<a<1. Original E norm and coefficient lambda/2*a*(1-a). Finite values follow internally; endpoint weights need not be added to the source statement.
Universal p,q in V and EVERY global coordinate subgradient at p, not merely a chosen support. Pairing uses e(q-p); quadratic penalty uses original norm(q-p).

derived_not_assumed: finite real identities at every point of V
same support used for both converse endpoint inequalities

definition_audit.SourceSubdifferential: Literal set of all g satisfying forall ambient u, f(e.symm(e p))+coe(inner g (u-e p)) <= f(e.symm u). No default selection and no finite-point restriction hidden in definition.
definition_audit.effectiveDomain: Below-top set, which generically includes bottom; hf separately excludes bottom.
definition_audit.SourceProper: Global no-bottom plus genuine finite witness.
definition_audit.strong_convexity: Expanded EReal interpolation, with properness/convex domain/nonnegative coefficient as external source standing assumptions.
